The structure of Ho₂MgNi crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms—8 Ho, 4 Mg, and 4 Ni—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Ho centers 12 geometric neighbors (8 Ho, 2 Mg, 2 Ni) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mg and Ni each have 10 neighbors (8 Ho, 2 Mg/Ni). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and edge sharing between Ho 12-vertex and Mg 10-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner and face sharing between Ho 12-vertex and Ni 10-vertex polyhedra.
